note: Hand labels for relevance, topic tags and severity, aligned by index to scripts/fixtures/newsClusteringEval.json articles. Labeled by Claude from HEADLINES ONLY against news-sourcing-design.md sections 3 (scope), 4a (tags) and 5 (severity) - a judgment, not an independent human label. relevance: "1" = in-scope report, "A" = in-scope but analysis/feature/explainer (not a report; no severity), "0" = out of scope, "?" = borderline (excluded from training and scoring). Tags are the design 8; severity is critical|major|significant|routine. Many tag and severity calls are debatable, and only 11 items are critical - treat as noisy.
